flow-definition.description: HEADSLING Android APK / AAB 构建、签名、验证及可选 Google Play 上传。默认从本地 /Users/daisei/HeadGame 已保存源码快照构建，支持 Git 分支；源码必须使用独立存储桶 headsling-assets-664894817585。保留 VERSION_CODE 参数及 Jenkins 构建编号。管线源：/Users/daisei/HeadGame/Jenkinsfile.android。

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: VERSION_CODE
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Positive Android versionCode; blank uses Jenkins BUILD_NUMBER.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: ARTIFACT_FORMAT
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: APK for direct installation; AAB for bundle validation or Google Play.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: SIGNING
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Debug supports test APK/AAB builds; Google Play uploads must use Release.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: UPLOAD_GOOGLE_PLAY
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Upload and publish a Release AAB to all eligible internal testers on Google Play.

hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.name: GOOGLE_PLAY_RELEASE_NOTES
hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.description: Optional zh-CN release notes (maximum 500 characters). A build-specific default is used when blank.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: CLEAN_LIBRARY
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Delete the Unity Library cache before building.
